sentences.text: Mr.P.K.Mishra, learned counsel for the appellant nos.2 to 5-claimants in MACA No. 823 of 2019 and respondent nos.2 to 5 in MACA No.104 of 2023 and Mr.B.K.Sahoo, learned counsel for the appellant-Insurance Company in MACA No.104 of 2023 and respondent No.2-Insurance Company in MACA No.823 of 2019 are present.
Vakalatnama filed by Mr. G.P. Dutta and associates on behalf of respondent no.2-Insurance Company in MACA No.823 of 2019 is filed and taken on record.
The memos in support of the compromise between the parties in both the cases are kept in the record.

2. Mr. P.K. Mishra, learned counsel for the claimants has filed a memo in MACA No. 823 of 2019 which is at Flag 'B' stating that the appellant No.1-Ghanashyam Mahakud (who is respondent No.1 in MACA No.104 of 2023) has died during pendency of the appeal leaving behind his legal heirs who are there on record in both the appeals.
Hence, his name may be deleted from the cause title of the appeals.
3. Considering the said submissions, the name of appellant No.1- Ghanashyam Mahakud is deleted from MACA No.823 of 2019 and as respondent No.1 in MACA No.104 of 2023.

Both the appeals have been filed challenging a common judgment dated 19.08.2019 passed by the learned 1st MACT, Keonjhar in M.A.C. Case No.229 of 2017 under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act wherein the learned Tribunal had directed the Insurance Company to pay a sum of Rs.20,60,000/- (Rupees twenty lakhs sixty thousand only) as compensation with simple interest @
7% per annum from the date of filing of the claim application, i.e., 25.09.2017 to the claimants till actual payment is made.
MACA No.823 of 2019 has been filed by the claimants for enhancement of the compensation and MACA No.104 of 2023 has been filed by the Insurance Company.
MACA No.104 of 2023 appears to be barred by time.

5. It is now agreed between the claimant nos.2 to 5 and the Insurance Company that a consolidated amount of Rs.26,00,000/- (Rupees twenty six lakhs only) which includes interest, shall be paid by the Insurance Company to the appellant Nos.2 to 5-claimants in MACA No.823 of 2019 who are respondent Nos.2 to 5 in MACA No.104 of 2023, within a period of eight weeks from today.

Ghanashyam Mahakud (Dead) vs Taramani Sarangi on 13 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18905322/
2 6.
The compromise memo signed by Mr.P.K.Mishra, learned counsel for the claimants-appellants and Mr.G.P.Dutta, // 4 // learned counsel for the Insurance Company is available in the record.

7. It is therefore directed that the Insurance Company shall deposit the aforesaid consolidated amount of Rs.26,00,000/- (Rupees twenty six lakhs only) before the Tribunal within a period of eight weeks from today and the same shall be reapportioned between the claimants proportionately by the Tribunal.
8.
As the settlement is arrived at before the National Lok Adalat, no court fee shall be levied.
Since statutory deposit has not been made by the Insurance Company, no order for refund is necessary.
9. The MACAs are accordingly disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(Savitri Ratho) Judge nd 2 National Lok Adalat Bichi Signed by: BICHITRANANDA SAHOO Designation: Personal Assistant Reason: Authentication
